paragraphs: Lily and Mia are in the park. They are at the playground. It is a nice day. Pip is here too. Mia has a big black camera. "Take a picture of Pip," says Lily. Mia puts the camera on a blue chair. "Where is Pip?" asks Lily. Pip runs to a tree. He is behind the tree. "Woof!" says Pip.

Mia looks at the blue chair. "Where is the camera?" she asks. It is not on the chair. Lily looks in the sand. "Is it in the sand?" asks Mia. "No, it is not here," says Lily. Pip sits next to a red chair. He looks under it. "Woof, woof!" says Pip.

Lily looks under the red chair. "I can see it!" she says. The black camera is under the red chair. Mia has the camera again. "Thank you, Pip!" says Mia. Mia takes a picture of Pip. Pip has a big smile. Lily and Mia are happy.
text.summary: Lily and Mia lose a black camera at the playground. Pip looks under a red chair and finds it.
